Chapter 4

Cluster Installation and Upgrade集群安装与升级

The first domain of the curriculum refers to typical tasks you’d expect of a Kubernetes administrator. Those tasks include understanding the architectural components of a Kubernetes cluster, setting up a cluster from scratch, and maintaining a cluster going forward. At the end of this chapter, you will understand the tools and procedures for installing and maintaining a Kubernetes cluster.

考试大纲的第一个考试域，对应你作为 Kubernetes 管理员所应完成的典型任务。这些任务包括理解 Kubernetes 集群的架构组件、从零搭建集群，以及后续的集群维护。学完本章，你将掌握安装和维护 Kubernetes 集群的工具与流程。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives对应考试大纲目标

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objectives:

本章覆盖以下考试大纲目标：

  • Prepare underlying infrastructure for installing a Kubernetes cluster为安装 Kubernetes 集群准备底层基础设施
  • Understand extension interfaces (CNI, CSI, CRI, etc.)理解扩展接口（CNI、CSI、CRI 等）
  • Create and manage Kubernetes clusters using kubeadm使用 kubeadm 创建并管理 Kubernetes 集群
  • Manage the lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters管理 Kubernetes 集群的生命周期
  • Implement and configure a highly available control plane实现并配置高可用控制平面

Provisioning the Infrastructure基础设施的准备

The infrastructure required by Kubernetes cluster nodes consist of servers, networks, and storage. Provisioning of the infrastructure is done by configuring those resources on premises or in the cloud, optimally in an automated fashion. That’s the purpose of infrastructure automation tools like Ansible and Terraform.

Kubernetes 集群节点所需的基础设施包括服务器、网络和存储。基础设施准备就是在本地数据中心或云上配置这些资源，最好以自动化的方式完成——这正是 Ansible、Terraform 等基础设施自动化工具的用途。

Even though “provisioning the infrastructure” has been mentioned in the curriculum exam, a detailed discussion of this topic would go beyond the scope of this book and isn’t directly related to Kubernetes. If you are more interested in the topic, have a look at the book Infrastructure as Code by Kief Morris (O’Reilly, 2025).

尽管考试大纲提到了“准备基础设施”，但深入讨论会超出本书范围，且与 Kubernetes 本身没有直接关系。如果你对该主题更感兴趣，可以阅读 Kief Morris 所著的《Infrastructure as Code》（O’Reilly，2025）。

— PDF p.55 —

Understanding Extension Interfaces理解扩展接口

Chapter 2 laid the foundation for understanding the Kubernetes architecture, node types, and their cluster components. Kubernetes architecture has been designed to be flexible, modular, and extensible so that the core functionality of the platform can be expanded. You can extend the cluster using extensions. Extensions are components that can be plugged into the platform to support custom functionality not native to Kubernetes. Those plug-ins usually include functions like network plug-ins, device plug-ins, and storage plug-ins.

第 2 章为理解 Kubernetes 架构、节点类型及其集群组件打下了基础。Kubernetes 架构在设计上强调灵活、模块化和可扩展，以便平台核心功能能够被扩展。你可以使用扩展来扩展集群。扩展是可以插入平台、以支持 Kubernetes 原生不具备的自定义功能的组件。这些插件通常包括网络插件、设备插件和存储插件等功能。

This section talks about critical interfaces that you will need to understand as a Kubernetes administrator:

本节介绍作为 Kubernetes 管理员必须理解的几个关键接口：

  • Container Network Interface (CNI)容器网络接口（CNI）
  • Container Runtime Interface (CRI)容器运行时接口（CRI）
  • Container Storage Interface (CSI)容器存储接口（CSI）

Container Network Interface (CNI)容器网络接口（CNI）

The CNI is a specification and the corresponding libraries for writing plug-ins to configure network interfaces in Linux containers. In Kubernetes, the CNI is responsible for establishing network connections between Pods running in the cluster. You will need to install a CNI plug-in in the control plane node(s) for them to function properly. “Installing a Pod Network Add-on” on page 38 demonstrates the installation process of a CNI.

CNI 是一组规范及相应库，用于编写在 Linux 容器中配置网络接口的插件。在 Kubernetes 中，CNI 负责在集群中运行的 Pod 之间建立网络连接。你需要在控制平面节点上安装一个 CNI 插件，它们才能正常工作。第 38 页“Installing a Pod Network Add-on”演示了 CNI 的安装过程。

Popular choices include Calico, flannel, Cilium, and cloud-specific solutions like AWS VPC CNI and Azure CNI.

常见选择包括 Calico、flannel、Cilium，以及 AWS VPC CNI、Azure CNI 等云厂商特定方案。

Container Runtime Interface (CRI)容器运行时接口（CRI）

The container runtime is responsible for managing the lifecycle of containers and ensuring that containers receive the resources they requested. Kubernetes uses containerd as its default container runtime, however, you can swap it out with a different container runtime if needed. The CRI is an API facilitating the interaction between Kubernetes and different container runtimes.

容器运行时负责管理容器的生命周期，并确保容器获得其所请求的资源。Kubernetes 默认使用 containerd 作为容器运行时，但如有需要也可以换成其他容器运行时。CRI 是一个 API，用于方便 Kubernetes 与不同容器运行时之间的交互。

— PDF p.56 —

Common providers include containerd (the most popular), CRI-O, Docker Engine (via cri-dockerd), and Mirantis Container Runtime, with roughly 10–15 production-ready runtime options available that implement the CRI specification.

常见的运行时提供方包括 containerd（最流行）、CRI-O、Docker Engine（通过 cri-dockerd）和 Mirantis Container Runtime；大约有 10–15 个生产就绪的运行时选项实现了 CRI 规范。

Container Storage Interface (CSI)容器存储接口（CSI）

Despite the fact that Kubernetes provides a volume plug-in system, it was hard to integrate third-party storage solutions. In response, CSI was developed as a standard to implement plug-ins for integrating arbitrary block and file storage systems to containerized workloads.

尽管 Kubernetes 提供了 volume 插件体系，但集成第三方存储解决方案一直比较困难。为此，CSI 被开发为一项标准，用于实现把任意块存储和文件存储系统集成到容器化工作负载的插件。

Leading providers include cloud native options like AWS EBS CSI, Azure Disk CSI, and GCE Persistent Disk CSI, along with storage system drivers from NetApp, Pure Storage, Portworx, and Rook/Ceph, totaling over one hundred CSI drivers available in the ecosystem for various storage backends from cloud providers to traditional storage vendors.

主流提供方包括 AWS EBS CSI、Azure Disk CSI、GCE Persistent Disk CSI 等云原生方案，以及 NetApp、Pure Storage、Portworx、Rook/Ceph 等存储系统驱动；生态中共有一百多个 CSI 驱动，覆盖从云厂商到传统存储厂商的各种存储后端。

Using kubeadm使用 kubeadm

The low-level command-line tool for performing cluster bootstrapping operations is called kubeadm. It is not meant for provisioning the underlying infrastructure.

用于执行集群引导（bootstrapping）操作的底层命令行工具称为 kubeadm。它并不负责准备底层基础设施。

To install kubeadm, follow the installation instructions in the official Kubernetes documentation. While not explicitly stated in the CKA frequently asked questions (FAQ) page, you can assume that the kubeadm executable has been preinstalled for you.

安装 kubeadm 请遵循 Kubernetes 官方文档中的安装说明。虽然 CKA 常见问题（FAQ）页面没有明说，但你可以假定考试环境已经为你预装了 kubeadm 可执行文件。

The following sections describe the processes for creating and managing a Kubernetes cluster on a high level and will use kubeadm heavily. For more detailed information, see the step-by-step Kubernetes reference documentation I will point out for each of the tasks.

接下来的小节在较高层面描述创建和管理 Kubernetes 集群的流程，并会大量使用 kubeadm。更详细的信息请参阅我为每个任务指出的 Kubernetes 分步参考文档。

Installing a Cluster安装集群

The most basic topology of a Kubernetes cluster consists of a single node that acts as the control plane and the worker node at the same time. By default, many developer-centric Kubernetes installations like minikube or Docker Desktop start with this configuration. While a single-node cluster may be a good option for a Kubernetes playground, it is not a good foundation for scalability and high-availability reasons. At the very least, you will want to create a cluster with a single control plane and one or many nodes handling the workload.

Kubernetes 集群最基础的拓扑由单个节点构成，该节点同时充当控制平面和工作节点。默认情况下，minikube、Docker Desktop 等面向开发者的 Kubernetes 安装都采用这种配置。单节点集群适合作为 Kubernetes 试验场，但出于可扩展性和高可用性考虑，它并不是良好的基础。至少你应该创建一个由单个控制平面和一个或多个处理工作负载的节点组成的集群。

— PDF p.57 —

This section explains how to install a cluster with a single control plane and one worker node. You can repeat the worker node installation process to add more worker nodes to the cluster. You can find a full description of the installation steps in the official Kubernetes documentation. Figure 4-1 illustrates the installation process.

本节讲解如何安装一个由单个控制平面和一个工作节点组成的集群。你可以重复工作节点的安装过程，向集群添加更多工作节点。完整的安装步骤描述见 Kubernetes 官方文档。图 4-1 展示了安装流程。

Initializing the Control Plane Node初始化控制平面节点

Start by initializing the control plane on the control plane node. The control plane is the machine responsible for hosting the API server, etcd, and other components important to managing the Kubernetes cluster.

首先在控制平面节点上初始化控制平面。控制平面是负责托管 API server、etcd 以及其他对管理 Kubernetes 集群至关重要组件的机器。

Open an interactive shell to the control plane node using the ssh command. The following command targets the control plane node named kube-control-plane running Ubuntu 24.10:

使用 ssh 命令打开到控制平面节点的交互式 shell。下面的命令目标是运行 Ubuntu 24.10、名为 kube-control-plane 的控制平面节点：

$ ssh kube-control-plane
Welcome to Ubuntu 24.10 (GNU/Linux 6.11.0-8-generic aarch64)
...

Initialize the control plane using the kubeadm init command. You will need to add the following two command-line options: provide the IP addresses for the Pod network with the option --pod-network-cidr. With the option --apiserver-advertise-address, you can declare the IP address the API Server will advertise to listen on.

使用 kubeadm init 命令初始化控制平面。你需要加上下面两个命令行选项：用 --pod-network-cidr 提供 Pod 网络的 IP 地址段；用 --apiserver-advertise-address 声明 API Server 将通告并监听的 IP 地址。

— PDF p.58 —

By default, kubeadm uses its own version to determine the control plane node’s version. For example, if you use kubeadm version 1.31.1, then it will use version 1.31.1 for the initialized node. You can provide the desired Kubernetes version by providing the --kubernetes-version option, though it is recommended to use the kubeadm version you want to use for the nodes.

默认情况下，kubeadm 用自身版本来决定控制平面节点的版本。例如，如果你使用 kubeadm 1.31.1，那么初始化的节点也会使用 1.31.1。你可以通过 --kubernetes-version 选项指定期望的 Kubernetes 版本，但建议让节点使用的版本与 kubeadm 版本一致。

The console output renders a kubeadm join command. Keep that command around for later. It is important for joining worker nodes to the cluster in a later step.

控制台输出会打印一条 kubeadm join 命令。请把这条命令保存好，后面加入工作节点时要用到它。

Retrieving the join command for worker nodes获取工作节点的 join 命令

You can always retrieve the join command by running kubeadm token create --print-join-command on the control plane node should you lose it.

如果丢失了 join 命令，随时可以在控制平面节点上运行 kubeadm token create --print-join-command 重新获取。

The following command uses 10.244.0.0/16 for the Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR):

下面的命令使用 10.244.0.0/16 作为无类别域间路由（CIDR）地址段：

$ sudo kubeadm init --pod-network-cidr=10.244.0.0/16
...
To start using your cluster, you need to run the following as a regular user:

  mkdir -p $HOME/.kube
  sudo cp -i /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf $HOME/.kube/config
  sudo chown $(id -u):$(id -g) $HOME/.kube/config

You should now deploy a pod network to the cluster.
Run "kubectl apply -f [podnetwork].yaml" with one of the options listed at:
  https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/addons/

Then you can join any number of worker nodes by running the following on \
each as root:

kubeadm join 172.16.0.5:6443 --token fi8io0.dtkzsy9kws56dmsp \
    --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash \
    sha256:cc89ea1f82d5ec460e21b69476e0c052d691d0c52cce83fbd7e403559c1ebdac

After the init command has finished, run the necessary commands from the console output:

init 命令完成后，运行控制台输出中给出的必要命令：

$ mkdir -p $HOME/.kube
$ sudo cp -i /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf $HOME/.kube/config
$ sudo chown $(id -u):$(id -g) $HOME/.kube/config
— PDF p.59 —

Installing a Pod Network Add-on安装 Pod 网络插件

You must deploy a Container Network Interface (CNI) plug-in so that Pods can communicate with each other. You can pick from a wide range of networking plug-ins listed in the Kubernetes documentation. Popular plug-ins include flannel, Calico, and Cilium. Sometimes you will see the term add-ons in the documentation, which is synonymous with plug-in.

你必须部署一个容器网络接口（CNI）插件，Pod 之间才能互相通信。你可以从 Kubernetes 文档列出的众多网络插件中挑选。流行插件包括 flannel、Calico 和 Cilium。有时文档中会使用 add-ons 一词，它与 plug-in（插件）同义。

The exam will most likely ask you to install a specific add-on. Most of the installation instructions live on external web pages which are not permitted to be used during the exam. Make sure that you search for the relevant instructions in the official Kubernetes documentation. For example, you can find the installation instructions for flannel on GitHub.

考试很可能会要求你安装某个特定插件。大多数安装说明位于外部网页，而考试期间不允许访问这些页面。请务必在 Kubernetes 官方文档中搜索相关说明。例如，flannel 的安装说明可以在 GitHub 上找到。

The following command installs the flannel objects via the released YAML manifest:

下面的命令通过发布的 YAML manifest 安装 flannel 相关对象：

$ kubectl apply -f https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/releases/latest/\
download/kube-flannel.yml
namespace/kube-flannel created
serviceaccount/flannel created
clusterrole.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/flannel created
clusterrolebinding.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/flannel created
configmap/kube-flannel-cfg created
daemonset.apps/kube-flannel-ds created

The YAML manifest hard-codes the Pod CIDR to the value 10.244.0.0/16. If you want to change that value, you’d have to download the YAML manifest first, edit the corresponding value, and then apply the manifest.

该 YAML manifest 把 Pod CIDR 硬编码为 10.244.0.0/16。如果你想改这个值，需要先下载 YAML manifest，编辑对应的值，然后再 apply。

You may decide to install flannel using Helm instead, either because you prefer the installation method or because you want to more conveniently provide a custom Pod CIDR. Helm offers the --set option to inject the custom value. The following command shows the use of Helm to install flannel. Refer to “Working with Helm” on page 90 to learn more about the use of Helm:

你也可以选择用 Helm 安装 flannel，要么因为偏好这种安装方式，要么因为想更方便地提供自定义 Pod CIDR。Helm 提供 --set 选项来注入自定义值。下面的命令演示了如何用 Helm 安装 flannel。关于 Helm 的更多用法参见第 90 页“Working with Helm”：

$ kubectl create ns kube-flannel
$ kubectl label --overwrite ns kube-flannel pod-security.kubernetes.io/\
enforce=privileged
$ helm repo add flannel https://flannel-io.github.io/flannel/
$ helm install flannel --set podCidr="10.244.0.0/16" --namespace kube-flannel \
  flannel/flannel
namespace/kube-flannel created
namespace/kube-flannel labeled
"flannel" has been added to your repositories
NAME: flannel
LAST DEPLOYED: Wed Jan 29 23:03:33 2025
— PDF p.60 —
NAMESPACE: kube-flannel
STATUS: deployed
REVISION: 1
TEST SUITE: None

Both installation methods, the YAML manifest and the Helm chart, create the flannel Pod into the namespace kube-flannel. Wait until the Pod observes the Running status. You can check on the Pod’s details with the following command:

两种安装方式（YAML manifest 和 Helm chart）都会把 flannel Pod 创建到 kube-flannel 命名空间中。等待 Pod 进入 Running 状态。可以用下面的命令查看 Pod 详情：

$ kubectl get pods -n kube-flannel
NAME                    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
kube-flannel-ds-h6455   1/1     Running   0          25s

Verify that the control plane node indicates the Ready status using the command kubectl get nodes. It might take a couple of seconds before the node transitions from the NotReady status to the Ready status. You have an issue with your node installation if the status transition does not occur. Refer to Part VI for debugging strategies:

用 kubectl get nodes 命令确认控制平面节点显示 Ready 状态。节点从 NotReady 变为 Ready 可能需要几秒钟。如果状态没有转变，说明节点安装有问题。调试策略参阅第 VI 部分：

$ kubectl get nodes
NAME                 STATUS   ROLES           AGE     VERSION
kube-control-plane   Ready    control-plane   5m31s   v1.31.1

Exit the control plane node using the exit command:

使用 exit 命令退出控制平面节点：

$ exit
logout
...

Joining the Worker Nodes加入工作节点

Worker nodes are responsible for handling the workload scheduled by the control plane. Examples of workloads are Pods, Deployments, Jobs, and CronJobs. To add a worker node to the cluster so that it can be used, you will have to run a couple of commands, as described next.

工作节点负责处理由控制平面调度的工作负载。工作负载的例子有 Pod、Deployment、Job 和 CronJob。要把工作节点加入集群并投入使用，需要按下面所述运行几条命令。

Open an interactive shell to the worker node using the ssh command. The following command targets the worker node named kube-worker-1 running Ubuntu 24.10:

使用 ssh 命令打开到工作节点的交互式 shell。下面的命令目标是运行 Ubuntu 24.10、名为 kube-worker-1 的工作节点：

$ ssh kube-worker-1
Welcome to Ubuntu 24.10 (GNU/Linux 6.11.0-8-generic aarch64)
...

Run the kubeadm join command provided by the kubeadm init console output on the control plane node. The following command shows an example. Remember that the IP address, token, and SHA256 hash will be different for you:

在控制平面节点上运行 kubeadm init 控制台输出给出的 kubeadm join 命令。下面是一个示例。请记住，你的 IP 地址、token 和 SHA256 哈希值会不同：

$ sudo kubeadm join 172.16.0.5:6443 --token fi8io0.dtkzsy9kws56dmsp \
  --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash \
  sha256:cc89ea1f82d5ec460e21b69476e0c052d691d0c52cce83fbd7e403559c1ebdac
[preflight] Running pre-flight checks
[preflight] Reading configuration from the cluster...
[preflight] FYI: You can look at this config file with \

'kubectl -n kube-system get cm kubeadm-config -o yaml'
[kubelet-start] Writing kubelet configuration to file \
"/var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml"
[kubelet-start] Writing kubelet environment file with \
flags to file "/var/lib/kubelet/kubeadm-flags.env"
[kubelet-start] Starting the kubelet
[kubelet-start] Waiting for the kubelet to perform the TLS Bootstrap...

This node has joined the cluster:
* Certificate signing request was sent to apiserver and a response was received.
* The Kubelet was informed of the new secure connection details.

Run 'kubectl get nodes' on the control plane to see this node join the cluster.

You won’t be able to run the kubectl get nodes command from the worker node without copying the administrator kubeconfig file from the control plane node. Follow the instructions in the Kubernetes documentation to do so, or log back into the control plane node. Here, we are just going to log back into the control plane node. You should see that the worker node has joined the cluster and is in a Ready status:

如果不从控制平面节点复制管理员 kubeconfig 文件，你将无法在工作节点上运行 kubectl get nodes 命令。可以按照 Kubernetes 文档的说明操作，或者重新登录回控制平面节点。这里我们直接重新登录回控制平面节点。你应该能看到工作节点已加入集群并处于 Ready 状态：

$ ssh kube-control-plane
Welcome to Ubuntu 24.10 (GNU/Linux 6.11.0-8-generic aarch64)
...
$ kubectl get nodes
NAME                 STATUS   ROLES           AGE     VERSION
kube-control-plane   Ready    control-plane   2m14s   v1.31.1
kube-worker-1        Ready    <none>          6m43s   v1.31.1

You can repeat the process for any other worker node you want to add to the cluster.

对于任何想加入集群的其他工作节点，都可以重复这一过程。

Managing a Highly Available Cluster管理高可用集群

Single control plane clusters are easy to install; however, they present an issue when the node is lost. Once the control plane node becomes unavailable, any ReplicaSet running on a worker node cannot re-create a Pod due to the inability to talk back to the scheduler running on a control plane node. Moreover, clusters cannot be accessed externally anymore (e.g., via kubectl), as the API server cannot be reached.

单控制平面集群安装简单，但节点一旦丢失就会出问题。控制平面节点不可用后，工作节点上运行的 ReplicaSet 由于无法与控制平面上的调度器通信，就无法重新创建 Pod。此外，由于 API server 不可达，集群也无法从外部（例如通过 kubectl）访问。

High-availability (HA) clusters help with scalability and redundancy. For the exam, you will need a basic understanding about configuring them and their implications. Given the complexity of standing up an HA cluster, it’s unlikely that you’ll be asked to perform the steps during the exam. For a full discussion on setting up HA clusters, see the Kubernetes documentation.

高可用（HA）集群有助于可扩展性和冗余。考试只要求你对其配置和影响有基本理解。由于搭建 HA 集群相当复杂，考试不太可能要求你实际执行这些步骤。关于搭建 HA 集群的完整讨论，见 Kubernetes 文档。

— PDF p.62 —

Stacked etcd Topology堆叠式 etcd 拓扑

The stacked etcd topology involves creating two or more control plane nodes where etcd is colocated on the node. Figure 4-2 shows a representation of the topology with three control plane nodes.

堆叠式 etcd 拓扑是指创建两个或更多控制平面节点，etcd 与控制平面节点同机部署。图 4-2 展示了三个控制平面节点的拓扑示意。

Each of the control plane nodes hosts the API server, the scheduler, and the controller manager. Worker nodes communicate with the API server through a load balancer. I recommende that you operate this cluster topology with a minimum of three control plane nodes for redundancy reasons due to the tight coupling of etcd to the control plane node. By default, kubeadm will create an etcd instance when joining a control plane node to the cluster.

每个控制平面节点都托管 API server、scheduler 和 controller manager。工作节点通过负载均衡器与 API server 通信。由于 etcd 与控制平面节点紧耦合，出于冗余考虑，我建议这种集群拓扑至少使用三个控制平面节点。默认情况下，把控制平面节点加入集群时 kubeadm 会创建一个 etcd 实例。

External etcd Node Topology外部 etcd 节点拓扑

The external etcd node topology separates etcd from the control plane node by running it on a dedicated machine. Figure 4-3 shows a setup with three control plane nodes, each of which runs etcd on a different machine.

外部 etcd 节点拓扑把 etcd 与控制平面节点分离，在专用机器上运行 etcd。图 4-3 展示了一个三控制平面节点的部署，每个控制平面节点对应的 etcd 都运行在另一台不同的机器上。

— PDF p.63 —

Similar to the stacked etcd topology, each control plane node hosts the API server, the scheduler, and the controller manager. The worker nodes communicate with them through a load balancer. The main difference here is that the etcd instances run on a separate host. This topology decouples etcd from other control plane functionality and therefore has less of an impact on redundancy when a control plane node is lost. As you can see in the illustration, this topology requires twice as many hosts as the stacked etcd topology.

与堆叠式 etcd 拓扑类似，每个控制平面节点托管 API server、scheduler 和 controller manager，工作节点通过负载均衡器与它们通信。主要区别在于 etcd 实例运行在单独的主机上。这种拓扑把 etcd 与其他控制平面功能解耦，因此控制平面节点丢失时对冗余的影响较小。如插图所示，这种拓扑需要的主机数量是堆叠式 etcd 拓扑的两倍。

Upgrading a Cluster Version升级集群版本

Over time, you will want to upgrade the Kubernetes version of an existing cluster to pick up bug fixes and new features. The upgrade process has to be performed in a controlled manner to avoid the disruption of workload currently in execution and to prevent the corruption of cluster nodes.

随着时间推移，你会希望升级现有集群的 Kubernetes 版本，以获得 bug 修复和新特性。升级过程必须受控地进行，以避免中断正在执行的工作负载，并防止集群节点损坏。

It is recommended to upgrade from a minor version to a next higher one (e.g., from 1.31.0 to 1.32.0), or from a patch version to a higher one (e.g., from 1.31.0 to 1.31.3). Abstain from jumping up multiple minor versions to avoid unexpected side effects. You can find a full description of the upgrade steps in the official Kubernetes documentation. Figure 4-4 illustrates the upgrade process.

建议从一个次版本升级到下一个次版本（例如从 1.31.0 到 1.32.0），或从一个补丁版本升级到更高的补丁版本（例如从 1.31.0 到 1.31.3）。不要一次跨多个次版本升级，以免出现意外副作用。完整的升级步骤描述见 Kubernetes 官方文档。图 4-4 展示了升级流程。

— PDF p.64 —
— PDF p.65 —

Upgrading Control Plane Nodes升级控制平面节点

As explained earlier, a Kubernetes cluster may employ one or many control plane nodes to better support high-availability and scalability concerns. When upgrading a cluster version, this change needs to happen for control plane nodes one at a time. Pick one of the control plane nodes that contains the kubeconfig file (located at /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf), and open an interactive shell to the control plane node using the ssh command. The following command targets the control plane node named kube-control-plane running Ubuntu 24.10:

如前所述，Kubernetes 集群可能使用一个或多个控制平面节点，以更好地支持高可用和可扩展性。升级集群版本时，控制平面节点需要逐个升级。挑选一个包含 kubeconfig 文件（位于 /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf）的控制平面节点，用 ssh 命令打开交互式 shell。下面的命令目标是运行 Ubuntu 24.10、名为 kube-control-plane 的控制平面节点：

$ ssh kube-control-plane
Welcome to Ubuntu 24.10 (GNU/Linux 6.11.0-8-generic aarch64)
...

First, check the nodes and their Kubernetes versions. In this setup, all nodes run on version 1.31.1. We are dealing with only a single control plane node and a single worker node:

首先查看节点及其 Kubernetes 版本。在本例中，所有节点都运行 1.31.1。我们这里只有一个控制平面节点和一个工作节点：

$ kubectl get nodes
NAME                 STATUS   ROLES           AGE     VERSION
kube-control-plane   Ready    control-plane   4m54s   v1.31.1
kube-worker-1        Ready    <none>          3m18s   v1.31.1

Start by upgrading the kubeadm version. Identify the version you’d like to upgrade to. On Ubuntu machines, you can use the following apt-get command. The version format usually includes a patch version (e.g., 1.20.7-00). Check the Kubernetes documentation if your machine is running a different operating system:

先升级 kubeadm 版本。确定你想升级到的版本号。在 Ubuntu 机器上可以使用下面的 apt-get 命令。版本格式通常包含补丁版本（例如 1.20.7-00）。如果你的机器运行其他操作系统，请查阅 Kubernetes 文档：

$ sudo apt update
...
$ sudo apt-cache madison kubeadm
   kubeadm | 1.31.5-1.1 | https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.31/deb  Packages
   kubeadm | 1.31.4-1.1 | https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.31/deb  Packages
   kubeadm | 1.31.3-1.1 | https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.31/deb  Packages
   kubeadm | 1.31.2-1.1 | https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.31/deb  Packages
   kubeadm | 1.31.1-1.1 | https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.31/deb  Packages
   kubeadm | 1.31.0-1.1 | https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.31/deb  Packages

Upgrade kubeadm to a target version. Say you’d want to upgrade to version 1.31.5-1.1. The following series of commands installs kubeadm with that specific version and checks the currently installed version to verify:

把 kubeadm 升级到目标版本。假设你想升级到 1.31.5-1.1。下面这组命令安装该特定版本的 kubeadm，并检查当前安装的版本以作验证：

$ sudo apt-mark unhold kubeadm && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install \
  -y kubeadm=1.31.5-1.1 && sudo apt-mark hold kubeadm
Canceled hold on kubeadm.
...
Unpacking kubeadm (1.31.5-1.1) over (1.31.1-1.1) ...
Setting up kubeadm (1.31.5-1.1) ...
kubeadm set on hold.
$ sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --allow-change-held-packages \
— PDF p.66 —
  kubeadm=1.31.5-1.1
...
kubeadm is already the newest version (1.31.5-1.1).
0 upgraded, 0 newly installed, 0 to remove and 94 not upgraded.
$ kubeadm version
kubeadm version: &version.Info{Major:"1", Minor:"31", GitVersion:"v1.31.5", \
GitCommit:"af64d838aacd9173317b39cf273741816bd82377", GitTreeState:"clean", \
BuildDate:"2025-01-15T14:39:21Z", GoVersion:"go1.22.10", Compiler:"gc", \
Platform:"linux/arm64"}

Check which versions are available to upgrade to and validate whether your current cluster is upgradable. You can see in the output of the following command that we could upgrade to version 1.31.5:

检查可升级到哪些版本，并验证当前集群是否可升级。从下面命令的输出可以看到，我们可以升级到 1.31.5：

$ sudo kubeadm upgrade plan
...
[upgrade] Fetching available versions to upgrade to
[upgrade/versions] Cluster version: 1.31.5
[upgrade/versions] kubeadm version: v1.31.5
I0130 22:26:53.887541   13574 version.go:261] remote version is \
much newer: v1.32.1; falling back to: stable-1.31
[upgrade/versions] Target version: v1.31.5
[upgrade/versions] Latest version in the v1.31 series: v1.31.

As described in the console output, we’ll start the upgrade for the control plane. The process may take a couple of minutes. You may have to upgrade the CNI plug-in as well. Follow the provider instructions for more information:

如控制台输出所述，我们将开始控制平面的升级。该过程可能需要几分钟。你可能还需要升级 CNI 插件。更多信息请遵循插件提供方的说明：

$ sudo kubeadm upgrade apply v1.31.5
...
[upgrade/version] You have chosen to change the cluster version to "v1.31.5"
[upgrade/versions] Cluster version: v1.31.5
[upgrade/versions] kubeadm version: v1.31.5
...
[upgrade/successful] SUCCESS! Your cluster was upgraded to "v1.31.5". Enjoy!

[upgrade/kubelet] Now that your control plane is upgraded, please proceed \
with upgrading your kubelets if you haven't already done so.

Drain the control plane node by evicting the workload. Any new workload won’t be schedulable on the node until uncordoned:

通过驱逐工作负载来 drain 控制平面节点。在 uncordon 之前，任何新工作负载都不会被调度到该节点上：

$ kubectl drain kube-control-plane --ignore-daemonsets
node/kube-control-plane cordoned
WARNING: ignoring DaemonSet-managed Pods: kube-system/calico-node-qndb9, \
kube-system/kube-proxy-vpvms
evicting pod kube-system/calico-kube-controllers-65f8bc95db-krp72
evicting pod kube-system/coredns-f9fd979d6-2brkq
pod/calico-kube-controllers-65f8bc95db-krp72 evicted
pod/coredns-f9fd979d6-2brkq evicted
node/kube-control-plane evicted

Upgrade the kubelet and the kubectl tool to the same version:

把 kubelet 和 kubectl 工具升级到同一版本：

— PDF p.67 —
$ sudo apt-mark unhold kubelet kubectl && sudo apt-get update && sudo \
  apt-get install -y kubelet=1.31.5-1.1 kubectl=1.31.5-1.1 && sudo apt-mark \
  hold kubelet kubectl
...
Setting up kubelet (1.31.5-1.1) ...
Setting up kubectl (1.31.5-1.1) ...
kubelet set on hold.
kubectl set on hold.

Restart the kubelet process:

重启 kubelet 进程：

$ sudo systemctl daemon-reload
$ sudo systemctl restart kubelet

Reenable the control plane node so that the new workload can become schedulable:

重新启用控制平面节点，使其可以调度新的工作负载：

$ kubectl uncordon kube-control-plane
node/kube-control-plane uncordoned

The control plane node should now show the usage of Kubernetes 1.31.5:

控制平面节点现在应显示使用 Kubernetes 1.31.5：

$ kubectl get nodes
NAME                 STATUS   ROLES           AGE   VERSION
kube-control-plane   Ready    control-plane   21h   v1.31.5
kube-worker-1        Ready    <none>          21h   v1.31.1

Exit the control plane node using the exit command:

使用 exit 命令退出控制平面节点：

$ exit
logout
...

Upgrading Worker Nodes升级工作节点

Pick one of the worker nodes and open an interactive shell to the node using the ssh command. The following command targets the worker node named kube-worker-1 running Ubuntu 24.10:

挑选一个工作节点，用 ssh 命令打开到该节点的交互式 shell。下面的命令目标是运行 Ubuntu 24.10、名为 kube-worker-1 的工作节点：

$ ssh kube-worker-1
Welcome to Ubuntu 24.10 (GNU/Linux 6.11.0-8-generic aarch64)
...

Upgrade kubeadm to a target version. This is the same command you used for the control plane node, as explained earlier:

把 kubeadm 升级到目标版本。这与前面在控制平面节点上使用的命令相同：

$ sudo apt-mark unhold kubeadm && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install \
  -y kubeadm=1.31.5-1.1 && sudo apt-mark hold kubeadm
Canceled hold on kubeadm.
...
Unpacking kubeadm (1.31.5-1.1) over (1.31.1-1.1) ...
Setting up kubeadm (1.31.5-1.1) ...
kubeadm set on hold.
$ kubeadm version
kubeadm version: &version.Info{Major:"1", Minor:"31", GitVersion:"v1.31.5", \
— PDF p.68 —
GitCommit:"af64d838aacd9173317b39cf273741816bd82377", GitTreeState:"clean", \
BuildDate:"2025-01-15T14:39:21Z", GoVersion:"go1.22.10", Compiler:"gc", \
Platform:"linux/arm64"}

Upgrade the kubelet configuration:

升级 kubelet 配置：

$ sudo kubeadm upgrade node

Drain the worker node by evicting the workload. Any new workload won’t be schedulable on the node until uncordoned:

通过驱逐工作负载来 drain 工作节点。在 uncordon 之前，任何新工作负载都不会被调度到该节点上：

$ kubectl drain kube-worker-1 --ignore-daemonsets
node/kube-worker-1 cordoned
WARNING: ignoring DaemonSet-managed Pods: kube-system/calico-node-2hrxg, \

Upgrade the kubelet and the kubectl tool with the same command used for the control plane node:

使用与控制平面节点相同的命令升级 kubelet 和 kubectl 工具：

$ sudo apt-mark unhold kubelet kubectl && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get \
  install -y kubelet=1.31.5-1.1 kubectl=1.31.5-1.1 && sudo apt-mark hold kubelet \
  kubectl
...
Setting up kubelet (1.31.5-1.1) ...

Restart the kubelet process:

$ sudo systemctl daemon-reload

Reenable the worker node so that the new workload can become schedulable:

重新启用工作节点，使其可以调度新的工作负载：

$ kubectl uncordon kube-worker-1
node/kube-worker-1 uncordoned

Listing the nodes should now show version 1.31.5 for the worker node. You won’t be able to run kubectl get nodes from the worker node without copying the administrator kubeconfig file from the control plane node. Follow the instructions in the Kubernetes documentation to do so, or log back into the control plane node:

列出节点时，工作节点现在应显示版本 1.31.5。如果不从控制平面节点复制管理员 kubeconfig 文件，你将无法在工作节点上运行 kubectl get nodes。可以按 Kubernetes 文档说明操作，或者重新登录回控制平面节点：

$ kubectl get nodes
NAME                 STATUS   ROLES           AGE   VERSION

Exit the worker node using the exit command:

使用 exit 命令退出工作节点：

$ exit
logout
...

Summary本章小结

As a Kubernetes administrator, you need to be familiar with typical tasks involving the management of the cluster nodes. The primary tool for installing new nodes and upgrading a node version is kubeadm. The cluster topology of such a cluster can vary. For optimal results with redundancy and scalability, consider configuring the cluster with a high-availability setup that uses three or more control plane nodes and dedicated etcd hosts.

作为 Kubernetes 管理员，你需要熟悉涉及集群节点管理的典型任务。安装新节点和升级节点版本的主要工具是 kubeadm。这类集群的拓扑可以有多种。为了获得最佳的冗余与可扩展性，考虑采用高可用配置，使用三个或更多控制平面节点和专用的 etcd 主机。

Exam Essentials考试要点

Understand why you need to provision infrastructure理解为何需要准备基础设施

Every cluster node needs to run on a physical or virtual machine. Provisioning the hardware is the job of an administrator, though you will not need to have hands-on experience for the exam. Explore the manual and automated approaches for provisioning hardware, as you will need it for installing a cluster.

每个集群节点都需要运行在物理机或虚拟机上。准备硬件是管理员的工作，尽管考试不要求你具备动手经验。了解手动和自动化准备硬件的方式，因为安装集群时需要用到。

Know how to create a Kubernetes cluster from scratch掌握从零创建 Kubernetes 集群

Installing new cluster nodes and upgrading the version of an existing cluster node are typical tasks performed by a Kubernetes administrator. You do not need to memorize all the steps involved. The documentation provides a step-by-step, easy-to-follow manual for those operations. During the exam, pull up the relevant documentation and copy-paste the commands.

安装新集群节点和升级现有集群节点版本是 Kubernetes 管理员的典型任务。你不需要记住所有步骤。文档为这些操作提供了循序渐进、易于跟随的手册。考试时打开相关文档，复制粘贴命令即可。

— PDF p.70 —

Practice the cluster upgrade process练习集群升级流程

The cluster upgrade process involves executing more commands than the installation process. It’s important to remember that you only jump up by a single minor version or multiple patch versions before tackling the next higher version. I’d suggest you open the upgrade documentation page and walk through the process a couple of times.

集群升级过程涉及的命令比安装过程多。重要的是记住：每次只跨一个次版本，或跨多个补丁版本，然后再升下一个更高版本。建议你打开升级文档页面，把流程走几遍。

Have a theoretical understanding of high-availability cluster topologies从理论上理解高可用集群拓扑

High-availability clusters help with redundancy and scalability. For the exam, you will need to understand the different HA topologies, though it’s unlikely that you’ll have to configure one of them as the process would involve a suite of different hosts.

高可用集群有助于冗余和可扩展性。考试要求你理解不同的 HA 拓扑，但不太可能要求你实际配置其中一种，因为该过程涉及一整套不同的主机。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的参考答案见附录 A。

  1. Create a cluster with four nodes: one control plane node, and three worker nodes. Create a Pod named nginx that uses the container image nginx:1.27.4-alpine. Identify the node the Pod has been scheduled on. Evict all Pods from the node that runs the Pod at once. Do not use the kubectl delete pod command to perform the operation. Ensure that the Pod is not running anymore. Prerequisite: To create a cluster with four nodes using minikube, run the command minikube start --nodes 4.创建一个四节点集群：一个控制平面节点、三个工作节点。创建一个名为 nginx 的 Pod，使用容器镜像 nginx:1.27.4-alpine。找出该 Pod 被调度到的节点。一次性驱逐运行该 Pod 的节点上的所有 Pod。不要使用 kubectl delete pod 命令执行该操作。确保该 Pod 不再运行。前置条件：要用 minikube 创建四节点集群，运行命令 minikube start --nodes 4。
  2. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch04/upgrade-cluster-version of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Start up the virtual machines (VMs) running the cluster using the command vagrant up. The cluster consists of a single control plane node named kube-control-plane, and one worker node named kube-worker-1. Open an interactive shell into the control plane node and inspect the currently-used Kubernetes version by listing all the nodes. Upgrade all nodes of the cluster from Kubernetes 1.32.1 to 1.32.2. Once done, shut down the cluster using vagrant destroy -f. Prerequisite: This exercise requires the installation of the tools Vagrant and a VMware provider.进入已克隆的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中的目录 app-a/ch04/upgrade-cluster-version。使用命令 vagrant up 启动运行集群的虚拟机（VM）。集群由一个名为 kube-control-plane 的控制平面节点和一个名为 kube-worker-1 的工作节点组成。打开到控制平面节点的交互式 shell，通过列出所有节点来查看当前使用的 Kubernetes 版本。把集群所有节点从 Kubernetes 1.32.1 升级到 1.32.2。完成后使用 vagrant destroy -f 关闭集群。前置条件：本练习需要安装 Vagrant 工具和 VMware provider。
